summary: Trivial global flag setter. Computes the truthiness of the single integer argument (a1 != 0), stores the resulting BOOL into the global dword_8B8E2C (0x008B8E2C), and returns the same value. Called from VidMan_Init, so the flag likely records a video-manager enable/disable state, but the flag's consumers are not in this packet.

operations.description: Compute (a1 != 0) and store the resulting BOOL into the global flag dword_8B8E2C (0x008B8E2C).
Return the computed BOOL, identical to the value just stored in dword_8B8E2C.
